top_comments.text:
Random question. What was your starting point for learning this? And what training are you doing? just using a giant data source or trying for a specific domain? 

Been getting into it myself, but it’s harder then it looks when you start from zero :/

top_reply.author: @aiwanay
top_reply.text: For starting from zero, I recommend you first find what domain of Machine Learning interests you. I currently am getting into research in Efficient Architectures. Once you find a domain then use ai tools to make you a roadmap based on where you stand currently. I made a roadmap to learn basics of calculus (chain rule, derivatives), statistics, and python. I also recommend watching Andrej Karpathy’s Zero to Hero series on YouTube.
